'''FreeOTP''' is a [[free and open-source]] [[authenticator]] by [[Red Hat|Red Hat]]. It implements [[multi-factor authentication]] using [[HOTP]] and [[Time-based One-time Password Algorithm|TOTP]]. [[Tokenization (data security)|Tokens]] can be added by scanning a [[QR code]] or by manually entering the token configuration. It is licensed under the [[Apache License|Apache 2.0 license]], and supports [[Android (operating system)|Android]] and [[iOS]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Fontana |first1=John |title=Two-factor authentication finds home in Red Hat, Windows OS |url=https://www.zdnet.com/article/two-factor-authentication-finds-home-within-red-hat-windows-os/ |accessdate=2019-03-26 |website=ZDNet}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Lerch|first1=Ryan|title=freeOTP — an open source solution for authentication soft tokens|date=25 June 2014|url=https://fedoramagazine.org/freeotp-an-open-source-solution-for-authentication-soft-tokens/|website=fedoramagazine.org|publisher=Fedora Magazine|accessdate=4 April 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|access-date=2018-10-11|date=2016-09-09|language=en|title=Easily Improving Linux Security with Two-Factor Authentication|url=http://changelog.complete.org/archives/9707-easily-improving-linux-security-with-two-factor-authentication|website=complete.org}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>
